changes.from: ### Finding and changing observations
changes.to:
### Video clips

On Today, Send a clip sends a video of up to three minutes from your phone. TREE reads it into a draft observation with still photos. Nothing is kept until you read it and tap Keep this observation.

### Saved as you write

TREE saves an observation as a draft from its first word or photo. Unfinished ones wait under Your drafts, and on Today as An observation to finish.

### Finding and changing observations

changes.from: During toilet learning a child wears a diaper or pull-up, a child moves to underwear once reliably toilet trained with fewer than three accidents a week, and daily soiling means a diaper or pull-up.
changes.to: During toilet learning a child wears a diaper or pull-up. A child comes to school in underwear once they are fully independent in the bathroom and tell an educator when they need to go, since our bathrooms are a walk from the classes. Daily soiling means a diaper or pull-up.

changes.from: Educators reapply sunscreen after lunch or after nap.
changes.to: Educators reapply our school's sunscreen after lunch or after nap.

changes.from: On a creek walk there is at least one adult for every six children, and every child stays within an educator’s reach near the water.
changes.to: On a creek walk there is at least one adult for every six children, and every child stays within an educator’s reach near the water. A child on a creek walk holds an educator’s hand until the group returns. A child not ready to walk safely stays at school with another educator.
